How to measure

  • Bust: around the fullest part of your chest, keeping the tape level.
  • Waist: around your natural waist, the narrowest part of your torso.
  • Hip: around the fullest part of your hips, feet together.

Details

The Ella Petal Set is a romantic play of florals, texture, and thoughtful versatility—designed to bloom differently with every wear. Crafted in organic cotton twinkle satin, this four-piece floral set brings together softness, structure, and movement in a consciously crafted silhouette. The corset-style top features a detachable drape that can be styled in multiple ways—worn on the sleeves, draped at the back, or left open as a soft frill at the front. Braided net straps frame the neckline, while the back is finished with net tie knots and loops, allowing for an adjustable, feminine fit. The skirt is layered and versatile, starting with printed shorts underneath that can be worn on their own or paired with the floral scatter skirt. A detachable net layer can be added for extra volume and softness. For a seamless silhouette, the floral scatter skirt can be attached to the corset top using potli buttons, transforming the set into a fluid one-piece look. The gathered net layer features a pleated paper-bag waistband with slits designed for the potli button attachment, ensuring both comfort and thoughtful detailing. Finished with a complementary net bracelet and a braided headband, the Ella Petal Set is made for moments that call for playfulness, romance, and personal expression—because true style is meant to bloom your way.

Shipping & exchanges

Orders are dispatched within 3–7 business days. Delivery within India usually takes 3–7 business days after that, and you get a tracking link when your order ships. Shipping charges are shown at checkout.

Exchanges are offered for damaged, defective or wrong items reported within 2 days of delivery, unused and in original packaging. Sale items and gift cards can’t be exchanged, and refunds aren’t given as money.
